content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
My garage door opens when I only think ‘home’. I don’t press anything.
Openers respond to remotes, car integrations, or scheduled routines. Any phone automations, geofencing, or car-linked triggers enabled?
My car has HomeLink and my phone has location permissions on.
Those can coordinate entry. Does the door open at the same distance each time or only when the vehicle is in range?
Usually as I turn onto my street.
Event logs from the opener or app can show the trigger source—vehicle signal, keypad, or app.
A sequence of timestamps matched to route points can clarify whether the cue is geofence or remote.
